ideas.title: Uncovering the $9B Minnesota Scam
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $9B scam in Minnesota, including the role of AG Keith Ellison and the ongoing investigation into Nancy Guthrie
ideas.angle: Follow the money and potential government corruption
questions: What is the extent of the scam?
What is the role of government corruption?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scam and potential government corruption. By following the money and investigating those involved, we may be able to expose a significant case of fraud and corruption.
